entities.summary: Bosporan Kingdom, a political institution in Russia during Scythians & Ancient Steppe Civilisations (200 BCE–400). Grew from Persian King Darius I and Scythian Civilisation. Led to the emergence of Sarmatians & Greek Colonies.
